summary: Resize a file synchronously, including zero-length default and zero-filled extension behavior.

semantics.mutation: shrinks or extends file to requested byte length; extension reads as zero-filled bytes

caveats: Length validation and Node error types must be preserved.
Opening and rewriting the file is not equivalent; metadata/races and sparse-file behavior can differ.

tests.name: extension yields zero bytes
tests.expected_behavior: file length is 3 and newly extended bytes read as zero
